svg.title: Cell and boundary conservation budget
svg.desc: Three 0.5 m cells start with concentrations 1,2,1. During 0.2 s, rightward face fluxes are 0.3,0.5,0.2,0.1 m/s. New concentrations 0.92,2.12,1.04 give total amount 2.04 m: initial 2 m plus 0.04 m net boundary input.
